items.label: Material
items.value: Top Layer Cowhide Leather with durable gold-tone hardware. Come with strong metal magnetic-buckle closure for extra security. The removable zip pouch use durable fabric lining. It makes the handbag noble and practical, Highlights your feminine elegance

items.label: Dimensions
items.value: The leather bucket bag measures 9" (L) x 5" (W) x 12" (H), Max top length of bucket bag is 12.8 inches. The weighs of bag is 0.84 kg/1.85 pounds. The independent small storage bag measures 7.8" (L) x 4" (W) x 7.8" (H). Bucket bag fits up to MacBook Air 13 inches, not suitable for other models

items.label: Pocket Structure
items.value: Inner structure is the combination with main compartment + 1 x removable zip pouch. The pouch including:1 main pocket + 1 inner zipper slot + 2 slip slots, one of which is a cell phone pocket, another is for ID card or any tiny item. Exterior structure including 2 side slip pockets + 2 metal magnetic-snap pocket that in front & back side

items.label: Feature
items.value: Two shoulder straps design, one of them is leather strap, another is woven guitar strap, you can according to your liking change strap style, to match your outfit in all seasons! The two straps approximately 10.23 inch, two straps can be changed out to use as a shoulder bag or handbag
